# Semi-Dense Point Clouds {#semi-dense-point-clouds}

Project Aria's documentation and LSD-SLAM literature describe semi-dense
tracks, inverse-distance parameterization, and world-frame points
[@Engel2014LSD]. This compact page preserves that external background only.

ARIA-NBV's geometry, notation, data shape, and validation are owned by the
[Typst thesis](../../typst/thesis/main.typ) plus the relevant Python
docstrings/tests. For neighboring background see [ASE](../ase_dataset.qmd) and
[EFM3D embeddings](efm3d_scene_embeddings.qmd).
